rules.prepare: # The Perl of the prefix: configure takes the first one in the path # otherwise, which is the one of the tools folder also when building for # the target, and its path ends up in the scripts. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ PERL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/perl" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-nls
